EN: You! Don't move!
ZH: 你！不要动！

EN: This is a Brotherhood of Steel tactical operation.
ZH: 这是钢铁兄弟会的战术运作。

EN: Please divulge your identity.
ZH: 请说出你的身份。

EN: Nightmare, Your Worst.
ZH: 我是噩梦，你最可怕的噩梦。

EN: I'm just a Vault Dweller exploring the Wasteland.
ZH: 我只是一个探索废土的避难所居民。

EN: Well, we all feel safer with you guys around.
ZH: 好吧，我们都觉得待在你们周围更安全。

EN: You did? We had it covered, but thanks! Here, take these.
ZH: 真的么？我们已经搞定了，不过还是谢谢！来，拿着这些。

EN: Set weapons to maximum power.
ZH: 把武器设置成最大功率。

EN: Well, we don't care about you, so there!
ZH: 好吧，我们不在乎你，所以！

EN: Don't move - we need to scan you.
ZH: 不要动-我们需要扫描你。

EN: Moderate radiation, adequate hygiene, low brain activity...
ZH: 适度的辐射，充分的卫生，轻度大脑活动……

EN: This must be a Vault Dweller.
ZH: 这一定是一个避难所居民。

EN: Friend or Foe?
ZH: 朋友还是敌人？

EN: Friend. I killed those Brotherhood doofuses for you.
ZH: 朋友，我为你杀了那些兄弟会的笨蛋。

EN: Foe, fo' sho!
ZH: 当然是，敌人！

EN: You know what? I don't really care about your little spat.
ZH: 你知道么？我真的不在乎你们的小口角。

EN: One of your Dwellers has heard gunshots coming from a Super-Duper Mart while exploring the Wasteland! You should investigate.
ZH: 你的一个居民在探索废土的时候听到来自大无敌超市的枪声！应该去调查下。

EN: Super-Duper Trooper
ZH: 超级士兵

EN: Talk to both sides of the stand-off.
ZH: 和对峙的双方交谈。

EN: Investigate a stand-off at the Super-Duper Mart.
ZH: 调查大无敌超市里的对峙。

EN: Thank you for saving me!
ZH: 谢谢你们救了我！

EN: Some of the others managed to escape, but I didn't make it.
ZH: 有一些人成功逃走了，但我没有。

EN: They headed towards an old Chryslus building. Can you make sure they're okay?
ZH: 他们去了旧克莱斯勒大厦。你们能保证他们的安全吗？

EN: Synths and their Railroad supporters were captured by Raiders. They need to be found before something horrible happens!
ZH: 合成人和他们的铁路支持者们被掠夺者抓住了。必须在可怕的事情发生之前找到他们！

EN: Synth in a Pinch
ZH: 被绑架的合成人

EN: Rescue the kidnapped Synth.
ZH: 拯救被绑架的合成人。

EN: Rescue a kidnapped Synth!
ZH: 拯救被绑架的合成人！

EN: Vault Dwellers?!
ZH: 避难所居民？！

EN: Oh no, the Synths are mine! I'm gonna get a big reward from the Institute!
ZH: 哦不。合成人是我的！学院一定会送我一个大奖！

EN: Maybe not, but we'll take our chances!
ZH: 也许不会吧，但我们想试试看！

EN: Oh my gosh, you can't just ask someone if they're robots!
ZH: 哦我的天！你怎么能直接去问他们是不是机器人呢！

EN: You know, I... uhh... I'm just not sure! How strange.
ZH: 你知道嘛，我……呃……我真的不确定！真奇怪。

EN: The jumpsuits are kind of a giveaway, aren't they? Thanks for the advice.
ZH: 这些连体衣就是暴露你们的破绽，对吧？谢谢你的建议。

EN: Thank you so much. There was no way we could go back!
ZH: 非常感谢。我们是不可能回头的！

EN: We'll have to find someplace to hide and lay low for a while.
ZH: 我们必须找个地方躲起来，保持低调。

EN: But at least now we have a chance at a normal life.
ZH: 但是至少现在我们有机会过上正常的生活。

EN: No such thing as a “normal” life these days, I'm afraid.
ZH: 我恐怕现在根本没有什么“正常”的生活了。

EN: Are you really robots?
ZH: 你们真的是机器人吗？

EN: Where is this Institute, anyway?
ZH: 不过学院究竟在哪儿？

EN: You might want to think about finding different clothes.
ZH: 你也许应该想想去哪儿找些不同的衣服。

EN: Raiders are trying to ransom Synths back to the Institute. Time to step in and save the day!
ZH: 掠夺者们想要把合成人送回学院来索取赎金。是时候出手拯救他们了。

EN: Synths for Sale
ZH: 售卖的合成人

EN: Rescue the Synths!
ZH: 拯救合成人！

EN: Rescue the Institute Synths.
ZH: 拯救学院的合成人。

EN: You ain't from the Institute, are ya? Then you're dead meat!
ZH: 你们不是从学院来到是吧？那只能送你们上西天了！

EN: It's a hit! Actually, lots of hits.
ZH: 一记安打！其实是很多安打。

EN: Ball four! You get to walk, home that is.
ZH: 四坏球！保送——直接上本垒。

EN: I'm Slugger, captain of this ball club.
ZH: 我是斯洛格，棒球俱乐部的队长。

EN: It's the bottom of the ninth and we're up to bat.
ZH: 现在是九局下半，轮到我们上场击球。

EN: You going to swing this pitch or not?
ZH: 你这次要不要挥棒？

EN: I'll swing at it.
ZH: 我会挥的。

EN: I'll hold. I think you'll throw a ball.
ZH: 我先放着。我觉得你会扔球。

EN: Slugger the Raider is hosting a baseball game, but he forgot to invite you. Time to throw him out at home plate.
ZH: 掠夺者斯洛格正在举办一场棒球比赛，但他忘记邀请你了。是时候在本垒将他封杀出局了。

EN: Take Me Out to the Ball Game
ZH: 带我去比赛。

EN: Defeat Slugger.
ZH: 打败斯洛格。

EN: Beat Slugger the Raider at his own game.
ZH: 在掠夺者斯洛格自己的比赛里击败他。

EN: So you got to first base. We'll throw you out at second.
ZH: 所以你必须要拿下第一垒。我们会让你在第二垒出局。

EN: Infield double! Guess we need a double play boys!
ZH: 内野双打！看来我们需要双杀球员了！

EN: Third base! We'll make sure you never get home.
ZH: 三垒！我们会让你回不了本垒。

EN: Home run! Time to charge the field boys!
ZH: 全垒打！兄弟们，该冲上场了！

EN: Another squad could use your support at the RobCo Corporate Offices!
ZH: 罗伯科公司的办公楼里还有一队人需要你的支援！

EN: You definitely have a knack for this kind of work.
ZH: 你显然很擅长这类工作。

EN: We're going to make you an honorary Knight of the Brotherhood of Steel.
ZH: 我们将授予你钢铁兄弟会荣誉骑士的称号。

EN: Welcome to the team, soldier!
ZH: 欢迎加入我们，士兵！

EN: I'm honored. What are my orders?
ZH: 我很荣幸。我的任务是什么？

EN: In order to convince the Brotherhood of Steel that the Vault is worthy enough to be one of their outposts, we're clearing the Ghouls out of Vault 840.
ZH: 为了向钢铁兄弟会证明避难所值得成为他们的前哨，我们要清除840号避难所里的尸鬼。

EN: Taking Out the Trash
ZH: 清理垃圾

EN: Clear the Ghouls out of Vault 840.
ZH: 清理840号避难所的尸鬼。

EN: Clear the Ghouls from Vault 840.
ZH: 清理840号避难所的尸鬼。

EN: The Overseer of Vault 333 might help us find Paula Plumbkin, but first we have to kill Frank the Tank.
ZH: 333号避难所的监督者也许能帮助我们找到宝拉·普朗布金，但首先我们得杀掉“坦克弗兰克”。

EN: Tankbusting
ZH: 坦克终结者

EN: Kill Frank the Tank.
ZH: 消灭“坦克弗兰克”。

EN: Find and kill Frank the Tank.
ZH: 找到并消灭“坦克弗兰克”。

EN: I'm Frank the Tank, and I'm gunning for you fools!
ZH: 我就是“坦克弗兰克”，我的枪早就为你们这些傻瓜准备好了！

EN: Your Dwellers can always use a chance to improve their weapon skills. It's not quite a target range, but the next best thing.
ZH: 你的居民有机会可以提高他们使用武器的能力。虽然不是最好的，但用来练习应该不错。

EN: Target Practice
ZH: 射击练习

EN: Kill the Glowing Radroach.
ZH: 消灭发光辐射蟑螂。

EN: Go hunting for Radroaches.
ZH: 去猎杀辐射蟑螂吧。

EN: Test
ZH: 测试

EN: Hey, we're dwellers from a new vault. Do you want to be our friends?
ZH: 嘿，我们是来自新避难所的居民。想和我们做朋友吗？

EN: You have passed THE TEST.
ZH: 您完成了测试。

EN: Yes!
ZH: 太棒了！

EN: You have NOT passed THE TEST. Return when you can pass THE TEST.
ZH: 您没有完成测试。请在可以完成测试时回来。

EN: No.
ZH: 不好。

EN: This is just a test. Remain calm.
ZH: 这是一个测试，请不要惊慌。

EN: Perform the test.
ZH: 完成测试。

EN: Another day, another empty room.
ZH: 又过了一天，又是一个空房间。

EN: There's been so sign of Coach, or Rackie Jobinson's Jersey. Is he still out there? Does he really have the Jersey? Only one way to find out!
ZH: 没有教练或是棒球衫的影子。他到底还在吗？他是不是真的有棒球衫？只有这一种方法才能知道了。

EN: The 20th Inning
ZH: 第二十局

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Sure. I think. I've never been myself, but there *has* to be one, right?
ZH: 当然，我想。我自己从没下去过，但肯定有个底，对吧？

EN: You should ask my brother, he used to be the Overseer of this Vault.
ZH: 你应该问我的哥哥，他曾经是这个避难所的监督者。

EN: Look for Deathclaws being too afraid to chase you deeper.
ZH: 寻找死爪，因为太害怕而不敢追的太深。

EN: Oh, hello, I hadn't seen you there.
ZH: 哦，你好，我没看见你在那儿。

EN: We don't get many visitors down here, with all the critters and whatnot.
ZH: 这下面小动物什么的太多，所以没什么访客来。

EN: It only gets worse as you go deeper, or so my brother tells me.
ZH: 只有当你走得更深时会更糟糕，这是我哥哥告诉我的。

EN: He lives near the bottom, where it's cool and quiet.
ZH: 他住在底部附近，那里凉爽而安静。

EN: So, there *is* a bottom, then?
ZH: 所以说，是有一个底部的，然后呢？

EN: What can you tell us about this place?
ZH: 关于这个地方，你能告诉我们些什么？

EN: How much further down is your brother's place?
ZH: 离你哥哥的地方还有多远？

EN: More or less. Some robots continued to dig a bit more.
ZH: 多少有那么一点儿吧。一些机器人还在继续挖。

EN: I like the peace and quiet. It's pretty safe down here, you know?
ZH: 我喜欢平和和安静。这里很安全，你知道吗？

EN: Yup. That was our experiment, to have robots do all of the manual work.
ZH: 是的。那是我们的实验，让机器人做所有的人力工作。

EN: Yeah, I haven't seen him in a while. Maybe I'll visit him in the Spring.
ZH: 是的，我很久没见他了。也许我会在春天拜访他。

EN: My eyes must be deceiving me...
ZH: 我的眼睛一定在欺骗我……

EN: No one has come this deep in decades...
ZH: 几十年来都没有人走这么深了……

EN: Even then, very few people ever did. Robots built most of this Vault.
ZH: 即便如此，来过的人也屈指可数。这个避难所大部分是由机器人建造的。

EN: They malfunctioned, and just kept on digging until they broke down.
ZH: 他们出了故障，并继续向下挖直到他们坏了。

EN: This is the bottom then?
ZH: 那这是底部呢？

EN: Why do you stay here?
ZH: 你为什么待在这儿？

EN: So, this is the result of malfunctioning robots?!
ZH: 那么，这是机器人失灵的结果吗？！

EN: I think your brother misses you.
ZH: 我想你哥哥肯定很思念你。

EN: We've all heard rumors of a bottomless Vault, one that is deeper than any others that have been built, but now it seems we may have actually located it! We need to send a recon party to explore the Vault and unlock its deadly secret.
ZH: 我们都听说过一个无底避难所的谣言，一个比任何其他已经建造的避难所都深的地方。但现在看来，我们好像找到它了！我们需要派出一个侦察队去探索这个避难所，并揭开它的致命秘密。

EN: The Abyss
ZH: 无底洞

EN: Solve the secret of the Vault.
ZH: 解开避难所的秘密。

EN: Explore the depth of a bottomless Vault.
ZH: 探索无底避难所的深度。

EN: Abandon all hope, ye who enter here...
ZH: 进入这里的人，请放弃所有的希望……

EN: How deep does this actually go?
ZH: 这到底有多深？

EN: I'm staring into the abyss, but nothing's staring back.
ZH: 我凝视深渊，但没有什么凝视回来。

EN: Why build such a place? It makes no sense.
ZH: 为什么要建这样的地方？这没有道理。

EN: What, you can't hear it? But, it's so *loud*!
ZH: 什么，你听不见？但是，它是如此响亮！

EN: Thank you so much! Here, this might help.
ZH: 真是感激不尽。拿着，这可能会有所帮助。

EN: Really? It's so loud I can barely make out what you're saying!
ZH: 真的？它是如此大声我几乎不能弄清楚你在说什么！

EN: Welcome Dwellers! Boy are we glad to see you guys.
ZH: 欢迎，居民们！真高兴看到你们。

EN: That incessant wailing is driving everyone here mad.
ZH: 那不断的哀号让每个人都疯狂。

EN: Some say that it's an omen of death, and they might be right...
ZH: 有人说这是死亡的预兆，他们可能是对的……

EN: People are starting to attack each other!
ZH: 人们开始互相攻击！

EN: What does the wailing sound like?
ZH: 哀号的声音是什么样的？

EN: Don't worry, we'll take care of it.
ZH: 别担心，我们会处理的。

EN: We don't hear anything...
ZH: 我们什么也听不见……

EN: Then you're one of *them* and you must be killed!
ZH: 那么你就是他们中的一员，你必须被杀死！

EN: You'd better, or we'll kill you too!
ZH: 你最好是，不然我们连你一起杀！

EN: Okay. Sure. Whatever. Here you go!
ZH: 行。好吧。随便啦。给你！

EN: Nuts? NUTS?! I'll show you nuts!
ZH: 疯了吗？疯了吗？我会给你看疯子是什么样的！

EN: You! Make that noise stop right now!
ZH: 你们！现在让噪音停止！

EN: We can't think straight anymore...
ZH: 我们不能再思考……

EN: Killing other Settlers helps, but just for a little while.
ZH: 杀死其他定居者会有用，但只是一会儿。

EN: Sorry, but we can't hear anything.
ZH: 对不起，我们什么也听不见。

EN: Let us through! We'll take care of it.
ZH: 让我们过去！我们来解决它。

EN: Give us your weapons first, then we'll make it stop.
ZH: 先把武器给我们，我们就让它停下来。

EN: You guys are nuts!
ZH: 你们是疯子！

EN: Sure we can! It's for the greater good, or something...
ZH: 我们当然可以！这是为了更大的好处，或某事……

EN: Meh, we're just following orders.
ZH: 去你的，我们只是服从命令。

EN: Fine, we were done anyway.
ZH: 好吧，反正我们也该结束了。

EN: So you're the ones messing with our little experiment...
ZH: 所以你就是那些破坏我们小实验的人……

EN: We transmit the sound of a barn owl screeching directly into the Settlers' brains.
ZH: 我们把一只猫头鹰尖叫直接传送到定居者的大脑里。

EN: We then measure how quickly they turn against each other.
ZH: 然后我们看他们多久会反目。

EN: And, yes, we know owls are extinct. We've trained parrots to mimic them.
ZH: 是的，我们知道猫头鹰已经灭绝。我们训练鹦鹉模仿它们。

EN: You can't experiment on Settlers without their consent.
ZH: 没有他们的同意，你不能用定居者做实验。

EN: Your scientific experiment is enabling superstitious beliefs.
ZH: 你的科学实验正在助长迷信观念。

EN: We'll let you live if you give us the parrot.
ZH: 如果你把鹦鹉给我们，我们就让你活下去。

EN: We've received reports from nearby Settlers that their building is haunted by a wailing female spirit. That sounds unlikely, but we should investigate in the name of... Science! Don't worry, we'll honor your memory if the angry dead end up eating your souls.
ZH: 我们收到附近定居者的报告说，他们的建筑被一个哀号的女鬼骚扰。听起来不太可能，但我们应该以……科学的名义调查看看！不要担心，如果愤怒的亡灵吃掉了你们的灵魂，你们将被永远铭记。

EN: The Banshee's Keen
ZH: 女妖之恸哭

EN: Solve the mystery of the wailing spirit.
ZH: 解开哀嚎灵魂的秘密。

EN: Talk to Settlers.
ZH: 与定居者交谈。

EN: Talk to Settlers.
ZH: 与定居者交谈。

EN: Solve the mystery of a haunted building.
ZH: 解开鬼屋的秘密。

EN: Maybe the Settlers are hearing the Mole rats' mating calls?
ZH: 也许定居者听到的是鼹鼠交配对话？

EN: At least these we can shoot... unlike ghosts!
ZH: 至少我们可以开枪……不像鬼！

EN: Make it stop!
ZH: 让它停止！

EN: The banshee's keening for *you*!
ZH: 女妖正在为你恸哭！

EN: Great! Here, take this. Good deeds ought to be rewarded. Now get moving! There's no time to waste!
ZH: 太棒了！来，拿着这个，好人应该有好报。现在你们可以赶路了，已经没时间可浪费了！

EN: I'm in no shape to take on those Deathclaws myself. But I won't make you do it for free. Take this and get going! There's no time to waste!
ZH: 我自己一个人肯定没法搞定这些死爪的，我不会让你白白帮助我的。拿上这个赶路吧！没时间了！

EN: Wow. Another minute and I was going to be mincemeat.
ZH: 哇。只差一分钟我就变成肉馅了。

EN: Name's Bigsby. Nicky sent ya, didn't he? Much as I'd love to get to know ya, we've got a more pressing matter.
ZH: 我是比格斯比。是尼克派你们来的对吧？虽然我很想和你们好好聊聊，我们现在有更重要的问题要解决。

EN: The soul I was sent to rescue is about to get served up on a Deathclaw dinner platter!
ZH: 我奉命去救的那个人就要被摆上死爪的餐盘了！

EN: You're going to have to finish this job for me.
ZH: 你们帮我了结这一切吧。

EN: Let me at 'em!
ZH: 让我来教训下它们。

EN: Why don't you do it?
ZH: 你为什么不去做呢？

EN: Really? Oh, that'd be great! Thanks again! Now let's get out of here!
ZH: 真的吗？哦，那太好了！谢谢！现在我们走吧！

EN: Ah. I see. Well, thanks for the rescue anyway. Now let's get out of here!
ZH: 啊，我明白了。不管怎么样还是谢谢你们救了我。现在我们走吧！

EN: Holy cow! I thought I was done for! You're a real lifesaver, you know that?
ZH: 我的老天爷，我还以为我完蛋了！你们真是我的救命恩人！

EN: If you ever need anything, you just say the word!
ZH: 如果你们需要我做任何事，只要开口就行！

EN: How about you come live at my Vault?
ZH: 要不你来我的避难所住？

EN: Actually, I don't need another mouth to feed.
ZH: 其实，我可不想再多养一张嘴了。

EN: Nick's old pal Bigsby Brown has gone missing. An old file suggests he'd gone out in search of a missing Vault Dweller, but no one's heard from him since. Track down that sleuth!
ZH: 尼克的老伙计比格斯比·布朗失踪了。一份旧文件显示他出去侦查避难所居民失踪案件，之后就再也没有消息。赶紧去找找这名侦探吧！

EN: The Bigsby Brown Case
ZH: 比格斯比·布朗

EN: Find Bigsby Brown.
ZH: 找到比格斯比·布朗。

EN: Kill the Alpha Deathclaw.
ZH: 消灭领头死爪。
